description: This file defines classes related to YouTrack API data types, including exceptions, objects representing issues, comments, users, groups, projects, and other entities, along with their methods for data manipulation and error handling.
external_methods: hrow new \Exception("An instance of SimpleXMLElement expected!")

classes.name: YouTrackObject
classes.description: Base class for YouTrack data objects.

classes.name: YouTrackError
classes.description: Represents a YouTrack error, extending YouTrackObject.

classes.name: Issue
classes.description: Represents a YouTrack issue with methods to access related data.

classes.name: Attachment
classes.description: Represents a YouTrack attachment with method to get content.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Represents a YouTrack project with methods to get subsystems and create new ones.

classes.name: Subsystem
classes.description: Represents a subsystem of a project.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Represents a version in YouTrack with description and release date.

classes.name: ProjectCustomField
classes.description: Represents a project-specific custom field, with unimplemented method.

classes.name: EnumBundle
classes.description: Represents an enumeration bundle with value list.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructors for various classes, initializing with optional XML and connection object.

methods.name: _update_children_attributes
methods.description: Updates object children attributes from XML.

methods.name: get_reporter
methods.description: Get the user who reported the issue.

methods.name: has_assignee
methods.description: Check if the issue has an assignee.

methods.name: get_assignee
methods.description: Get the user assigned to the issue.

methods.name: get_updater
methods.description: Get the user who last updated the issue.

methods.name: get_comments
methods.description: Retrieve comments related to the issue.

methods.name: get_attachments
methods.description: Retrieve attachments related to the issue.

methods.name: get_links
methods.description: Retrieve links related to the issue.

methods.name: get_author
methods.description: Get the author of a comment.

methods.name: get_user
methods.description: Retrieve a user object by username.

methods.name: create_subsystem
methods.description: Create a new subsystem within a project.
